features.title: Synthetic administrative coordination draft policy
acceptance_criteria: Only synthetic, privacy-minimized coordination inputs are accepted
Missing consent, opt-out, urgency, clinical content, conflicts and timeouts escalate
Accepted drafts are marked human-review-required and cannot claim clinical or pricing authority
features.notes: No clinical decision, patient-facing send, CRM write or operational acceptance is claimed.
